ui.title: Keyboard shortcuts
ui.help: Click a shortcut, then press a new combination. Changes apply immediately in every window.
ui.recordHelp: Press Esc to cancel, or Tab to move on. Standard copy, paste, undo and redo keep their system shortcuts.
ui.invalid: Use Ctrl/Command or Alt with a letter, number or function key.
ui.conflict: This combination is assigned to another action. Disable or change that action first.
ui.reserved: This combination is reserved for system or text editing.
